excerpt.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
excerpt.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.
